name: @claudeqwq/opencli-plugin-tradingview
description: TradingView adapter for OpenCLI — chart automation control (symbol/timeframe switch, indicators incl. loading any public open-source Pine script by scriptIdPart, drawings, screenshot, saved layouts, batch anomaly scan, reading live study values for built-in and open-source Pine indicators via the Charting-Library widget API), plus navigation and structured extraction adapters (news, financials, technicals, macro calendar, earnings calendar)
